source_request: 제안해준 내용을 반영한 다음 독립된 환경의 서브에이전트에서 테스트해줘. 개발 전에 먼저 독립된 환경의 서브에이전트에서 "어두운 달빛 아래 빗자루를 타고 날아가는 네코미미 마녀가 KF-21 전투기에 쫓기며 대응 사격을 하는 긴급히 찍은 듯한 실사 촬영 이미지" 를 생성해두고 개발한 다음에 다시 한번 개선된 스킬로 이미지를 생성하고 두개를 비교해줘.

A dark, hurriedly captured live-action photographic appearance
baseline_prompt_en: A hurried photorealistic night photograph catches an unmistakably adult nekomimi witch, a human woman with two distinct triangular cat ears rising through her windblown hair, flying on a rough wooden broom beneath dim moonlight. She straddles the broom, both thighs gripping its shaft; her left hand braces on the forward handle while her torso twists over her right shoulder. With her free right hand she aims a short wand behind her and fires a sharp luminous projectile toward the pursuing KF-21 fighter jet. The aircraft is visibly closing from behind along the same flight path, its recognizable swept wings and twin tails cutting through broken low clouds; the glowing shot crosses the space between witch and jet. The broom bristles stream aft with her movement. Viewed from an oblique ground-level vantage, both figures remain in one unsettled frame with a slightly tilted horizon, imperfect edge crop, coarse high-ISO grain, and restrained motion streaks. Moonlit clouds and a faint rim on the ears and broom keep the scene dark while the return shot briefly illuminates her tense face.
